purpose: Define the minimum externally observed stabilization review areas for GLAZE UI V1.5 without manufacturing human, assistive-technology, device, privacy, performance, platform, Release Candidate, Stable, consumer, deployment, or production acceptance.

checks.description: Verify that permission-required, restricted, offline, degraded, temporarily unavailable, unsupported, and unknown states are understandable without implying authorization or success.
Verify that primary actions remain predictably ordered and that contextual adaptation does not create surprising or unsafe action movement.
Verify that navigation and composition changes preserve task continuity, current location, and understandable recovery behavior.
Verify keyboard and directional navigation, visible focus, logical focus order, and focus preservation across adaptive state changes.
Verify accessible names, roles, states, relationships, and meaningful assistive-technology announcement of capability and availability changes.
Verify Reduced Motion, Reduced Transparency, Increased Contrast or Forced Colors, large text, and applicable color-vision accommodations without semantic loss.
Verify representative supported browser or native runtime rendering and interaction behavior on an exact V1.5 revision.
Verify offline, reconnecting, degraded-service, and runtime-downgrade behavior without false capability or success claims.
Verify unsupported-effect and constrained-runtime fallbacks preserve semantics, usability, and authority boundaries.
Verify Glaze UI does not automatically request permission, manufacture consent, broaden purpose, or execute privacy-sensitive fallback behavior.
Verify diagnostics and adaptation summaries exclude credentials, private content, raw sensitive context, exact observation timestamps, and provider identity where not required.
Verify Privacy Shield, Wardveil Security, application, service, device, and other provider authority classes remain truthful, bounded, and fail closed on conflict or missing provenance.
Verify repeated context and capability transitions do not cause oscillation, visual jitter, focus churn, or unstable action ordering.
Verify low-power or performance-constrained adaptation reduces presentation cost without changing capability truth or protected semantic meaning.
Verify representative interaction and rendering behavior remains within the approved performance budget for the reviewed environment.

requiredEvidenceAreas.label: Platform, posture, input, and window adaptation

checks.description: Verify fold, unfold, posture, rotation, and other supported form-factor transitions preserve task and state continuity.
Verify supported touch, pointer, keyboard, remote or directional, and other declared input modes receive appropriate Glaze UI interaction behavior.
Verify constrained and expanded window states adapt composition without losing critical actions, current destination, or semantic hierarchy.

boundary: This contract defines review obligations only. A generated or completed record is not lifecycle promotion authority by itself, and no review result may be inferred from machine checks or absent evidence.
